coverage_issues: qwen model: .SRCINFO audit failed due to HTTP 400 API error, leaving that file unreviewed
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from security findings in the final verdict calculation - an HTTP 400 error is not an inconclusive security assessment

When one model encounters a tool error on a file that another model successfully reviews, the successful review should satisfy coverage requirements rather than forcing an overall inconclusive verdict
Models should explicitly note when they are reporting a tool failure versus a genuine inability to assess security
